title: Project P.I.T.T. Fuse Box Locations — All 3 Fuses & UP? Achievement
description: Project P.I.T.T.: the Fuse Box sits on the facility's upper catwalk (right-side elevated area), you need to find and place all three fuses, then tackle 200kg step.
h1: Project P.I.T.T. Fuse Box Locations — All 3 Fuses & UP? Achievement
quickAnswer: The Fuse Box is on the facility's upper/catwalk right-side elevated area; the box requires three Fuses (finding it alone won't complete the step); community reports and achievement indexes connect placing all three with the Steam-listed UP? achievement (Steam shows the achievement but provides no detailed description); after all three are placed the Fuse progression continues into the 200kg scale/weight-puzzle step.

facts.label: Fuse Box
facts.value: Located in an upper/catwalk area on the facility's right-side or otherwise elevated portion, per community descriptions.

facts.label: All 3 Fuses
facts.value: The Fuse Box requires three Fuses; you must place all three for the progression—finding the box alone does not complete the step.

facts.label: UP?
facts.value: UP? is a Steam achievement; community reports and achievement indexes consistently connect it to completing the Fuse step, while Steam's public listing does not include a detailed description.

facts.label: After completion
facts.value: Fuse Box → all 3 inserted → Fuse progression complete → continue to the 200kg scale/weight-puzzle progression.
